# Synthetic bridge fixture

This ten-second story is fictional. Its coordinates, geometry, and label do not
represent a real place, source, or research finding. `note.txt` is a local
synthetic asset whose SHA-256 is recorded in `project.json`. The fixture contains
300 frames at 30 fps, both target dimensions, camera keyframes, a point, line,
polygon, line and outer-ring trace intervals, and label fade intervals.

Run the bounded schema cases from the repository root with:

```sh
node --test tests/project-schema/validation.test.mjs
```

This fixture does not establish basemap readiness, rendering, package import,
asset rights review, or a complete project-format validator.
